notes.title: Grimmwood 1.0 released
notes.content:
We did it! Grimmwood 1.0 is available on Steam!

It said that quite a few people start something… but very few finish it. We’re real proud to announce that our first game as a studio is a fact! No in beta, not as early access, but as a fully-fledged online MMO:

> [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/809280/Grimmwood__They_Come_at_Night/]Store page[/url]
 
It was quite a journey so far, but it was all worth it – the good, the bad and the ugly, all of it. It’s a great feeling and this is only the beginning. So, come and join us in the Village – we’ll gather around the fire and everyone will tell their story of the day. But, mark our words, the journey has just begun. The best is yet to come!

notes.title: The Open Beta ends tomorrow, August 2nd, at 5pm CET (8am PDT)
notes.content:
Tomorrow is both a happy and a bit of a sad day for us. We really had a blast being together with all of you on the Grimmwood Open Beta. Over 20,000 unique players took part, which is really fantastic for a small indie title!

As of tomorrow, August 2nd, 5pm CET, Grimmwood: They Come at Night will be officially available for purchase on Steam which also means that the Open Beta support will be discontinued.

From the bottom of our hearts - thank you for taking part in the game’s development so far! It’s been quite a journey, hopefully – for both you and us. One thing is for sure – Grimmwood could never become what it is today without you! But the road is still ahead of us – together we can achieve great things. So bear with us – we won’t let you down! 

See you in the Village!

notes.title: Live Twitch Stream - The Road Ahead (Friday, July 27th, 9pm CET)
notes.content: Tomorrow at 9pm CET we’ll be streaming live on Twitch. The main focus will be our dev plans post launch (August 2nd). We’ll disclose what lies ahead for Grimmwood, sharing as much details as we can. For the first time we’ll talk about the possibility of an end game, single player mode and also a card game spin off. Meet you there!

notes.title: Grimmwood 0.8.0.0 and Blitz mode coming up today
notes.content:
Villagers,

The next update is coming up today (16-Jul-18) between 13:00 and 14:00 CET, so expect a short server downtime in that interval.

This update is huge, adding a completely different mode (Blitz), a lot of UI improvements and new features like loot drop of monsters and others! We hope that this will offer an enjoyable experience for the players that like the atmosphere and the idea of the game, but dislike the slow paced asynchronous multiplayer. Please let us know what you think once you can check it out - we care for each and every opinion shared.

The change log will be available in the corresponding Discussions thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/850290/discussions/0/1692669912403067408/

Enjoy!

notes.title: Twitch live stream - Introducing the Blitz Mode (July 13th, 9pm CET)
notes.content:
Hey there Fellow Villagers!

As you might have already heard – the Blitz Mode is upon us! To introduce the new game mode we’re organizing a live Twitch stream, this Friday night (July 13th,) starting at 9 pm CET ( https://www.twitch.tv/grimmwoodgame ).

The whole BMG team will be playing Blitz Mode in a single Village. Come and see for yourself how seriously can a developer suck at its own game :) We’ll try our best not to disappoint! And of course we will share lots on insight on what’s different in the Blitz Mode and how it should be approached. We’ll also try to answer as many of your questions as we can. So may the Forest Spirits have mercy on our mortal souls…

notes.title: Steam Stream, Episode 3 – June 22
notes.content:
We’ll start as usual at 21:00 CET. 

This time we will talk less of how Grimmwood works from the inside, and more about how it should look… and sound based on our actual dev plans.

Here’s the agenda for tonight:
1.	Answering some big questions from your own feedback.
2.	Introducing the “Terrain-Scapes” and the idea behind them
This is about the animated stills meant to introduce each terrain type and shown each time you go from one terrain to another on your local map.
3.	Introducing the new terrain sound ambiences
We’ll talk more about the basic idea behind it and why these should feel unique each time they are played in-game.
4.	Introducing the Grimmwood soundtrack
You’ll have the chance to be the first outside the studio to have a quick taste of the first couple of tracks of the forthcoming exclusive game soundtrack.

notes.title: Our first Steam Stream goes live tomorrow at 21:00 CET
Update, June 5th at 13:30 CET
Upcoming Update, June 5th at 13:30 CET
notes.content:
This Tuesday, June 5th, at 13:30 CET, we will be releasing one of our biggest updates yet. Along with all the bug fixes and balance fine-tuning, the following new features/updates will be included:

A new "Pick a Village to Play In" function 
With each new Character Creation the Player will get the right choose from a list of the currently opened Villages in which his/her Steam Friends are playing. The Player is also allowed to choose a random Village if he/she chooses to. Additional information will be displayed is displayed for each Village, showing which game day the Village is in, and how many Players are currently playing in it.
Important: Please note that in order to work this feature needs you to switch your Steam account to Public Mode (the default option.) 

Full French and Spanish Localization
Grimmwood will now be fully playable in both French and Spanish language (you need to choose the respective language from the in-game Options menu.) 

Faster and more effective “Banish a Player” procedure
•	The Banish vote will no longer be "nullified" at the end of the game day (if a majority hasn't been reached); Instead, the vote will stay active until a deciding condition is met, with no time limit; 
•	The vote deciding conditions will be: a) a 50% + 1 player have voted; or b) at least 5 Villagers have voted and there's at least one vote more either "for" or "against" (the deciding vote).
•	Once a vote has started, and there's at least 1 vote in favor, the respective Player will not be able to take any items from the Storage or craft items in the Workshop. 

Perk Re-rolls are now up to 10
You said you wanted more Perk re-rolls and we heard you. This will also give the players a better chance to experience the game from a new perspective.

Use of the Rejuvenation Elixir will be restricted to one elixir per day per Villager
This is to prevent a potential misuse of the Rejuvenation Elixir either by Griefers or inexperienced Players.

notes.title: Experiencing technical difficulties
notes.content:
Today we had technical server issues which might have prevented certain players from logging in the game. 

They might have been also some unexpected game related events, which appeared as bugs. We'd really apprceciate it if you can find the time to report any such occurrences in the in-game Feedback form (to be found in the in-game Options menu, top left corner) or in our What-Went-Wrong bug reporting Discord channel! 

We are investigating the problem as we write this. At the moment the game appears to be 100% playable. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your support and understanding!

notes.title: The basic Steam Friends matchmaking live today!
notes.content:
Today, from 14:30 – 14:45 (CET), there will be a planned server update. During that time the players won’t be able to connect to the game server, preventing them from playing. As always – our sincere apologies for the inconvenience!

The main reason for the update is the first iteration of the basic Steam Friends matchmaking. From this point on, each time a Player dies, he/she will be sent to an opened Village with the most of his/her Steam Friends currently playing. So, go on and make some new friends on Steam 😊 It’s going to be worth it 😊

As any other new feature, this one has also been thoroughly tested before going live. Nevertheless, if you encounter any problems or peculiarities, please let us know. Thank you!

notes.title: Planned Server Update, May 21st
notes.content:
Today, from 13:30 till 13:45 CET, there will be a planned server update. The update is needed for the faster Stamina Regeneration balance changes to take effect. 
During the update time the players will lose connection with the server, preventing them from playing the game. We apologize for the inconvenience!

notes.title: 200% faster Stamina Points regeneration!
notes.content:
We have re-worked the entire balance of the game to allow the Stamina to regenerate twice as fast in Rest Mode. This also means higher Stamina caps, higher regeneration by using Potions, and generally – more to do! Exactly as you wanted it 😊 You have spoken and we’ve heard you! For those who enjoy the game as it is – no worries, this won’t hurt the general Grimmwood feel. It will only give bigger margin for error, which also means – wider range for experimentation. The game has such an intriguing, wonderfully complex system, that it will be simply a shame if someone cannot experience it in full only because of the lack of Stamina.

Expect the server to be updated as early as possible next week for the balance changes to take effect. We’ll be testing the new balance all through the weekend to eliminate as many potential flaws as possible. But there’s only one real way to polish those changes to perfection and that’s by letting all of you guys play the game. So be there, play hard, give us your thoughts! 
You know we’ll be listening 😊
